image.description: URL of an image to use as the first frame of the video. If not provided, prompt is required.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Omit to match the input media.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# LTX 2.3 Pro Audio to Video

LTX 2.3 Pro audio-to-video: animate an image into a video that follows an audio track, such as a voice or song.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 5,000 characters. |
| `image` | image URL, required | — | Image to animate. JPEG, PNG, or WebP URL. |
| `audio` | audio URL, required | — | Audio that drives the video. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `16:9` / `9:16` | — | Output frame shape. |

## Billing

$0.10 per output second; the output is as long as the audio. The quote before submission assumes 5 seconds.

| Audio | Price |
|---|---|
| 5s audio | $0.50 |
| 10s audio | $1.00 |
| 20s audio | $2.00 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Describe the scene and motion; timing follows the audio.
